enchlib.treecut.config.title: Tree Cutting
enchlib.treecut.config.mode.desc: Choose how trees are cut when sneaking with an axe (stone tier or higher). Off: vanilla break. Fell: log by log with tree falling down. Chop: whole tree breaks. If Eldrich Surge is installed, automatically managed (fell without enchantment, chop with Lumberjack).
enchlib.axesareweapons.config.title: Axes as Weapons
enchlib.axesareweapons.config.desc: When enabled, axes lose only 1 durability point when attacking mobs (like swords), and can receive sword enchantments in both the enchanting table and anvil.
